title: feat: add Grok Imagine Image 2.0
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `grok-imagine-image-2.0` as a new paid-only model; no aliases and no changes to existing Grok image models.
- Routes the exact `x-ai/grok-imagine-image-2.0` ID through OpenRouter, pinned to xAI with provider fallback disabled.
- Supports low/medium quality, 1K/2K output, and up to three reference images across simple, OpenAI JSON, and multipart routes.
- Bills OpenRouter's exact output tiers ($0.04/$0.06/$0.06/$0.08) plus $0.01 per input image using request-selected cost variants.
- Widens the shared resolution schema for 1K/2K while retaining per-model validation; the adjacent Seedance edit is type-only.
- Verified direct provider calls and full local E2E: every tier, editing via `media.pollinations.ai`, `b64_json`/URL formats, permissions, billing, caching, validation errors, and concurrent burst. All measured generations finished within 67 seconds. Gen: 111 focused/invariant tests + typecheck. Enter: 81 pricing/invariant tests + typecheck.

gist.headline: Grok gets a new canvas
gist.blurb: A new paid-only Grok image model has landed in the garden. Bring up to three reference images, choose 1K or 2K, and let the pixels do their mysterious little thing.
gist.summary: Added the paid-only `x-ai/grok-imagine-image-2.0` model through OpenRouter with xAI pinned as provider, low/medium quality, 1K/2K output, and support for up to three reference images across simple, OpenAI JSON, and multipart image routes.
gist.impact: Developers can now generate or edit images with Grok Imagine Image 2.0 using reference images and request-selected output tiers priced at $0.04/$0.06/$0.06/$0.08 plus $0.01 per input image.
gist.visual_concept: Polli is an art director in a cozy garden studio, pinning three tiny reference pictures beside a retro CRT that renders a new image in selectable 1K and 2K frames. Glowing image seeds travel from the references into the monitor, while code-plants and flowers establish that this is a new API image model rather than a generic painting scene.

Lime green (#ecf874) glows prominently from code-plants and garden flowers around the desk, with soft mint, lavender, peach, and warm cream gradients; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
